reference: 2025 repetition of the validated 2024 ParkingSingleMuon J/psi tag-and-probe strategy

campaign_inputs.prompt_reco_policy: Use the latest PromptReco production for each 2025 era and ParkingSingleMuon primary dataset; C-v1 and F-v1 are superseded by v2.
campaign_inputs.mc_campaign_note: The dedicated 2025-conditions J/psi to dielectron sample supplies the resonant simulation efficiency; the parking HLT is data-only.

binning_policy: Use the same 3 eta by 2 pT grid as the 2024 correction candidate; the ECAL transition is removed before filling.
eta_policy: Barrel bins are 0--0.8 and 0.8--1.44; the combined endcap measurement is 1.566--2.5. The 1.44--1.566 ECAL transition is excluded.
target_selection: cutBased >= 1; miniPFRelIso_all is not an additional probe pass/fail requirement
denominator: reconstructed GSF electron with 5 < pT < 10 GeV passing the ECAL fiducial region, conversion veto, and lostHits <= 1, without a cutBased or mini-isolation requirement
tag: tight electron with pT > 5 GeV and miniPFRelIso_all < 0.1; no electron trigger-object match is applied
reference_trigger_strategy: ParkingSingleMuon records the event independently of the dielectron pair; no electron HLT or trigger-object requirement enters tag or probe selection.
adoption_gates: the 2025 golden JSON is applied to data and the 2025 pileup correction to simulation
the parking reference path is present and fired in adopted data; it is not applied to MC
no electron trigger-object matching or electron HLT requirement enters tag or probe selection
the 5--7 and 7--10 GeV bins have statistically usable passing and failing J/psi peaks
simultaneous pass/fail fit convergence in every adopted barrel bin
bin-by-bin stability under fit-model, fit-window, binning, tag-selection, and pileup variations
